new_primary_evidence.subject: Compiler identity is separate from runtime inclusion
new_primary_evidence.source: Official Android Gitiles LLVM project commit
new_primary_evidence.observed: The commit page identifies LLVM source revision 4c603efb0cca074e9238af8b4106c30add4418f6 and describes a merge/update to LLVM r450784. This corroborates the compiler/toolchain revision recorded in the ELF, not the AndroidX native source revision and not which runtime archive members entered the ELF.

new_primary_evidence.subject: C++ runtime defaults and license family
new_primary_evidence.source: Official Android NDK C++ library support documentation
new_primary_evidence.observed: The documentation says CMake defaults to c++_static, libc++ is available as static libc++_static.a or shared libc++_shared.so, and identifies the LLVM Project license as Apache License 2.0 with LLVM Exceptions. It also states that the no-STL option has no linking or licensing requirements.
new_primary_evidence.scope_limit: This current guide establishes the documented runtime choices/default and license family, not the exact historical 1.0.1 build configuration or whether any archive object was retained in this stripped release binary.

refined_findings.androidx_source_provenance: PARTIALLY RESOLVED: official release notes now map 1.0.1 to the exact graphics-path commit range above. The previously inspected historical mirror snapshot at 794e3806700833665f48f56f7dd3581642a6057f remains useful source-header context, but it is not an exact substitute for inspecting the 1.0.1 range.
refined_findings.published_binary_to_source_attestation: OPEN: no build attestation, native source archive, exact link command, or reproducibility record was present in the already inspected AAR/source metadata. The 1.0.1 source JAR has Kotlin files only, as documented in the preserved review.
refined_findings.static_runtime_inclusion: OPEN: libc++_shared.so is not a DT_NEEDED library, but CMake's documented default is c++_static. This makes static C++ runtime inclusion a possibility if that default applied and archive members were needed; neither condition has been established for this release. The existing ELF symbol and DT_NEEDED observations do not prove absence of static libc++, libc++abi, libunwind, or compiler-rt code.
refined_findings.runtime_license_obligations: NOT DETERMINED: if LLVM runtime code is incorporated, Android's NDK documentation identifies Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception as the LLVM license family; the actual included component(s), applicable third-party notices, and required notice set cannot be assigned without release build/link evidence or identifiable linked archive members. The POM's Apache-2.0 label is not used to close this question.
refined_findings.exact_historical_license_text: The previous review recorded that direct exact-commit LICENSE.TXT retrievals for libc++, libc++abi, libunwind, and compiler-rt returned 403. This review did not retry those URLs or seek a substitute route; exact historical texts and file contents remain unverified.

release_decision_relevance: The uncertainty is now narrower: AndroidX publicly identifies the source change range, while the remaining material gap is the source-range contents/binary build binding plus exact linked runtime objects/notices. Do not claim native release-license clearance or no runtime obligations from POM metadata or the absence of libc++_shared.so alone.
